answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via stake-backed Rate-Limiting Nullifiers. Each agent locks a bond on-chain to commit its key, then attaches a zero-knowledge proof and an epoch Shamir share to whisper messages across a peer trellis. Exceeding its epoch limit leaks shares so any verifying vertex can recover the key and slash the bond. Each fake identity thus costs locked liquid capital. Yet wealthy attackers can still fund many seats or rent idle quotas.
